facts.name: Bill section map
facts.described_as: The sections a bill of quantities prints, read from the document's own headings, in the order the document prints them: each section's number and its heading. An empty list means the document prints no section heading.

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.label: document id
inputs.described_as: The document, by the id a search or the document list returned.

hints.purpose: Returns the sections a bill of quantities prints, number and heading, in the order the document prints them, read from the document's own headings.

not_to_be_confused_with.difference: That one counts and totals rows; this one only names the sections the rows sit in.
That one lists documents; this one lists the sections inside one bill.

question_kinds.how: Answers what sections a bill has; for any other single passage search instead.
Gives the section's own heading words, so a total confined to one section passes words the bill really prints.
Shows which bill section holds the work a specification clause governs, before the rows are read.
A bill's section headings say nothing about a drawing.
